workList.orderExplanation: How order works: due now first, then future dates, then no date. Within each group, available work comes before blocked work, then priority, exact due date, title, and record ID. Closed work stays last.

rank.reason: Why here: {{due}} · {{availability}} · {{priority}}. Ties use {{exactDue}}, title “{{title}}”, then record ID {{id}}.
rank.closed: Why here: closed work stays last
